generation.scope: The full scheme degree d of the cofactors of an integral opposite octic in a reduced four-finite regular window is at most 24-HL, hence at most nineteen. The sectional endomorphism curve has arithmetic genus 21-d. At d=19 the sectional cokernel descends to a very ample degree-five line bundle embedding a Gorenstein genus-two curve on a unique quadric.

open_mathematics: Use the embedded genus-two sectional quintic and the exact trace defect to classify surface and curve kernels at full scheme degree nineteen, allowing rank-one curves.
